name: job agency
trans: n. 求职中介

name: agent
trans: n. an active and efficient cause; capable of producing a certain effect; a representative who acts on behalf of other persons or organizations

name: recruit
trans: v. register formally as a participant or member; seek to employ

name: available
trans: adj. obtainable or accessible and ready for use or service

name: vacant
trans: adj. void of thought or knowledge; without an occupant or incumbent

name: applicant
trans: n. a person who requests or seeks something such as assistance or employment or admission

name: personnel
trans: n. group of people willing to obey orders

name: job description
trans: n. description of the responsibilities associated with a given job

name: vouch
trans: v. give personal assurance; guarantee

name: referee
trans: n. (sports) the chief official (as in boxing or American football) who is expected to ensure fair play
v. be a referee or umpire in a sports competition

name: shift
trans: n. an event in which something is displaced without rotation; a qualitative change
v. make a shift in or exchange of; change place or direction

name: commute
trans: n. a regular journey of some distance to and from your place of work
v. exchange positions without a change in value; travel back and forth regularly, as between one's place of work and home

name: CV
trans: n. a summary of your academic and work history

name: résumé
trans: n. short descriptive summary (of events)

name: interview
trans: n. the questioning of a person (or a conversation in which information is elicited); often conducted by journalists; a conference (usually with someone important)

name: candidate
trans: n. a politician who is running for public office; someone who is considered for something (for an office or prize or honor etc.)

name: offer
trans: n. the verbal act of offering; something offered (as a proposal or bid)
v. make available or accessible, provide or furnish; present for acceptance or rejection

name: employer
trans: n. a person or firm that employs workers

name: employee
trans: n. a worker who is hired to perform a job

name: certificate
trans: n. a document attesting to the truth of certain stated facts

name: licence
trans: n. excessive freedom; lack of due restraint

name: work permit
trans: n. a legal document giving information required for employment of certain people in certain countries

name: experience
trans: n. the accumulation of knowledge or skill that results from direct participation in events or activities

name: quality
trans: n. an essential and distinguishing attribute of something or someone; a degree or grade of excellence or worth

name: personality
trans: n. the complex of all the attributes--behavioral, temperamental, emotional and mental--that characterize a unique individual; a person of considerable prominence

name: education background
trans: n. 教育背景

name: degree
trans: n. a position on a scale of intensity or amount or quality; a specific identifiable position in a continuum or series or especially in a process

name: major
trans: n. a commissioned military officer in the United States Army or Air Force or Marines; below lieutenant colonel and above captain

name: bachelor
trans: n. a man who has never been married

name: master
trans: n. an artist of consummate skill; a person who has general authority over others

name: suit
trans: n. a set of garments (usually including a jacket and trousers or skirt) for outerwear all of the same fabric and color

name: uniform
trans: n. clothing of distinctive design worn by members of a particular group as a means of identification

name: smart
trans: adj. showing mental alertness and calculation and resourcefulness; elegant and stylish

name: casual
trans: adj. marked by blithe unconcern; without or seeming to be without plan or method; offhand

name: salary
trans: n. something that remunerates

name: tip
trans: n. the extreme end of something; especially something pointed; a relatively small amount of money given for services rendered (as by a waiter)
v. cause to tilt; mark with a tip

name: pension
trans: n. a regular payment to a person that is intended to allow them to subsist without working

name: welfare
trans: n. governmental provision of economic assistance to persons in need; something that aids or promotes well-being

name: insurance
trans: n. promise of reimbursement in the case of loss; paid to people or companies so concerned about hazards that they have made prepayments to an insurance company
